title: ci(framework-build-base): tag every published base digest immutably, so a GHCR untagged cleanup or a rebuild: true never removes the digest cloud pins
body:
repo:cloud#2 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbWTyRFQwYN1hZXbCHL

Filing gate: ② defect with a named place, the publish half of objectstack-ai/cloud#3934, which can only be fixed here. Cloud PR objectstack-ai/cloud#3964 makes the loss loud on cloud's side (daily red card); only the publisher can make the digest durable. Dedupe: no open objectstack issue names framework-build-base, an immutable tag or untagged cleanup. Related: #31441 (published the base, closed).

## Problem

Cloud pins the framework build base image by digest in `.objectstack-base-image` (`ghcr.io/objectstack-ai/framework-build-base:PIN@sha256:DIGEST`, cloud PR #3898). Two ordinary events make that digest unservable:
- a GHCR retention or cleanup policy deleting untagged versions (a republish moves the PIN tag, leaving the old digest untagged), or
- republishing the same pin with `rebuild: true`, which moves the PIN tag to a new digest.

Cloud then falls back to the ~20 min source build for every staging, production, EE-verify and migration image (EE verify measured 24m09s from source vs 5m25s from the base, cloud PR #3898).

## Fix (proposal from the cloud#3934 thread)

- File: `.github/workflows/framework-build-base.yml`
- Change: (1, recommended) Tag every published digest immutably. The digest is only known after the push, so add a step right after 'Build and push' (if: steps.existing.outputs.skip != 'true', env DIGEST from the build step's digest output, SHA from steps.sha.outputs.sha): docker buildx imagetools create --tag "${IMAGE}:${SHA}-${DIGEST:7:12}" "${IMAGE}@${DIGEST}". Every digest then carries a tag of its own: a GHCR cleanup of untagged versions never takes it, and a rebuild: true that moves the SHA tag leaves the old digest served under SHA-DIGEST12, so cloud's committed .objectstack-base-image keeps resolving. Never delete or re-point a SHA-DIGEST12 tag (say so in the header next to 'A tag is written once'). (2, complementary) Refuse rebuild: true over a published pin unless a new boolean input replace_published is also true: in 'Is this commit already packaged', when DIGEST is non-empty, REBUILD is true and replace_published is not, print ::error naming the existing digest and the downstream step (cloud scripts/framework-base-image.sh write, then commit .objectstack-base-image) and exit 1.
- Why: cloud#3964 only makes the loss loud (daily red card within a day). The card's fix item 1 is to make the pinned digest durable, and only the publisher can do that: the tag is moved by the publish workflow, and untagged versions are what a GHCR retention policy deletes. (1) removes both causes at once without changing what the SHA tag means; (2) stops the deliberate case from silently moving the tag. With (1) in place cloud needs no change: it pins by digest, and the extra tag only keeps that digest alive.

## Done when

A published digest stays served under a tag of its own after a `rebuild: true` of the same pin and after an untagged-versions cleanup, and the workflow header says a SHA-DIGEST12 tag is never deleted or re-pointed.

Governed (`.github/workflows/**`): contract review + human approval. Not urgent while cloud has no `.objectstack-base-image` committed (cloud main today): the risk starts the day the first base pin lands.
